meta.name: infinitetalk-shopping-avatar
meta.description: 专为InfiniteTalk项目设计的小省导购员数字人带货提示词生成技能，基于四大智能体协同（提示词生成师、质量管控师、知识库运维师、跨环节适配师），生成适配Image-to-Video模式的结构化提示词（角色固定特征+动作时序+场景环境+音频匹配+光影氛围+技术约束），支持9:16竖屏、5s/幕、音频同步（Suno+chinese-wav2vec2-base）、一致性管控（角色/视觉/情绪），直接对接模型推理流程

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成带货数字人视频的结构化提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在InfiniteTalk项目中批量生成数字人带货视频提示词
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured prompts for shopping avatar videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch generate prompts for digital human shopping videos in InfiniteTalk

howto.what: Claude会扮演提示词生成师等角色，生成小省导购员带货视频的五幕提示词（每幕5s、9:16竖屏），涵盖角色特征、动作时序、场景、音频、光影和技术约束；还会做质量核查、知识库归档、工具对接。
howto.when: 当用户需要生成小省导购员数字人带货视频提示词，并使用InfiniteTalk模型推理时触发。

say.text: 帮小省导购员生成推荐保温杯的五幕带货提示词，竖屏9:16
say.note: 会产出五幕结构化提示词和参数配置表

say.text: 用产品推荐模板，情绪热情专业，生成五幕提示词
say.note: 会调取场景模板并生成完整提示词

say.text: 检查这段提示词的角色一致性和光影参数是否达标
say.note: 会按质量核查维度输出pass或问题清单

howto.what_en: Claude acts as prompt generator and other agents to create structured 5-scene prompts for Xiaosheng avatar shopping videos (5s/scene, 9:16 portrait), covering character, motion, scene, audio, lighting, and technical specs. It also checks quality, archives knowledge, and integrates tools like Suno.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to generate Xiaosheng shopping avatar video prompts and use InfiniteTalk for inference.

say_en.text: Create a 5-scene shopping prompt for Xiaosheng promoting a thermos, 9:16 portrait.
say_en.note: Outputs structured prompts and a parameter table.

say_en.text: Use the product recommendation template with enthusiastic tone to generate 5 scenes.
say_en.note: Loads the scene template and outputs full prompts.

say_en.text: Check this prompt for character consistency and lighting feasibility.
say_en.note: Returns pass or a list of issues.
